incident.summary: Surf native socket and tab.list were live, but every normal external Chrome navigation (example.com, neverssl.com, chatgpt.com) stayed visually blank/loading with empty title/url in Surf tab.list; content-script reads returned 'Content script not loaded' and screenshots timed out. The failure reproduced in a disposable Chrome profile, so this was system Chrome/browser readiness, not WebGPT semantics or a stale browser-oracle binding. Chrome UI reported 'Can't update Chrome' and apt showed installed google-chrome-stable 149.0.7827.53-1 with candidate 152.0.7977.75-1; sudo was required to reinstall/update.

proof_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
tabs=json.load(open('fixtures/chrome_blank_loading_tablist_20260903.json'))
tab=next((t for t in tabs if t.get('active')), None)
assert tab, 'NO_ACTIVE_TAB'
assert (tab.get('url') or '').startswith('https://example.com/'), tab
PY

regressions.notes: This regression prevents equating /tmp/surf.sock or tab.list success with browser readiness. Provider submits must not proceed when normal external pages never commit.
